title: Static Range Sums
statement:
Implement prefix sums to answer each inclusive range-sum query in O(1) after O(n) preprocessing.

Input
The first line contains n and q. The next line contains n signed integers. Each of the next q lines contains L R with 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ n.

Output
Print each sum on its own line.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 200000. Each value has absolute value at most 10⁹.
